inputs.pca_scores: Recomputed from the retained dataset with analyze.py helpers.
inputs.sys_use: Used after PCA fitting to interpret score association only.

interpretation_limits: Source labels are not PCA inputs; source_eta_squared measures post-fit alignment with source families.
High source_eta_squared does not prove source causation; it says source families occupy different regions in the fitted PCA coordinates.
PC-sys correlations are descriptive audits on already evaluated retained rows, not candidate-proposer rules.
